sloka: सा स्म याति दिवा रात्रम् महती हरि वाहिनी ।हृष्ट प्रमुदिता सेना सुग्रीवेण अभिरक्षिता ॥६-४-५९॥।।
transliteration: sā sma yāti divā rātram mahatī hari vāhinī ।hṛṣṭa pramuditā senā sugrīveṇa abhirakṣitā ॥6-4-59॥।।

translations.english: The terrible dust risen up by the (stamping) legs and hands of the vanara troops spread all over is keeping off Sun's radiance as if creating fear.Alas, the frightening army of vanaras went spreading all over the mountains and forests like the spread of clouds over the sky.
